integrity: The proof is exact and noncomputational. The no-Morse premise is taken from Proposition 3.5 of arXiv:2610.05626v1 and its Hessian obstruction was checked against the primary full text.
scientific_limitations: The construction is smooth and nonanalytic because it uses a flat multiplier. It does not address the real-analytic category or claim that the full local germ is insufficient; only the complete Taylor jet is shown insufficient.
title: Morse–Lyapunov existence is invisible to the full Taylor jet
